**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Permit the ownership marker in stored event metadata**

Every new or refreshed imported event now receives `_discoveryOwned`, but `EventMetadataDTO` still rejects every key except `ticketUrl`, `imageUrl`, `isPublic`, `currency`, and `budgetCents` (`SocialEventsHandlers.hs:1594-1623`). As soon as an event is imported or refreshed, `publicUpcomingEventRow` silently omits it because metadata decoding fails, while administrative read/update and finance paths using `decodeStoredEventMetadata` return errors. Store this evidence separately or update all metadata decoders and writers to accept and preserve the internal marker.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve editorial metadata during source reconciliation**

When an editor changes `ticketUrl` or sets `isPublic` to false, this ownership logic initially preserves the change, but every successful cron refresh immediately calls `reconcileProviderEvents` (`Cron.hs:617-624`), whose `refreshCanonicalVisibility` unconditionally rewrites both fields from provider references (`EventDiscovery.hs:2000-2007`). Consequently, a legacy imported event that an administrator hides can be republished on the next successful source run, and an editorial ticket URL is replaced despite being removed from `nextOwned`; make reconciliation honor/update the ownership snapshot rather than bypassing it.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
